subject: SaaSCo renewal: conditional rate-hold + commit uplift proposal
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Neal <tom.neal@saasco.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@saasco.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & capacity plan — SaaSCo (term through 2029)

Hi Tom / Lydia,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Attached is a clean SOW (SaaSCo_SOW_v3.pdf) and a short summary of the renewal options we discussed. High level:

- Proposed term: 12 months, start 2028-07-01.
- Baseline commit: 45M tokens / month.
- Discounting: 18% off list on the baseline commit, with stair-step pricing for +25% and +50% bands.
- Burst safety: 250k token burst pool available for 3 months; one-time usage credit option if you prefer a hard cap.

We can accommodate a temporary price-hold for a limited window if we can secure a modest commit uplift (helps us lock capacity on Dedicated). If that sounds reasonable, I can draft a conditional amendment (3-month rate-hold in exchange for +20% committed tokens).

Can you confirm which path you prefer (rate-hold + uplift / one-time credits / straight renewal at proposed discount)? If useful, I can set up a 30-minute call this week to finalize.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: SaaSCo_SOW_v3.pdf
From: Tom Neal <tom.neal@saasco.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity plan — SaaSCo (term through 2029)

Hannah —

Appreciate the options. Two quick asks from procurement:

1) Can Redwood hold current effective pricing for 6 months post-renewal? We had a usage spike in Q1 due to a promotional campaign and are nervous about a step change.
2) Can you provide a one-time offset credit for the overage we incurred in May? Our finance team is seeing a ~$28k delta from expected consumption.

If we can get a 6-month price-hold + a one-time $25k credit, we can likely commit to an uplift in the baseline. Otherwise we may need to push for a shorter hold window.

Looping in procurement (procurement@saasco.com) for visibility.

—Tom
Director of Product, SaaSCo
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal & capacity plan — SaaSCo (term through 2029)

Team — forwarding Tom's note. Key asks: 6-month price-hold (current effective pricing) and a ~$25k one-time offset credit for May overage. Tom indicates they'll likely uplift commit if we provide these.

Options I see:
- Option A (preferred sales): 3-month price-hold + conditional +20% baseline commit (committed for remainder of term) + $25k usage credit.
- Option B (procurement ask): 6-month price-hold + $25k credit (no uplift guaranteed).

Questions for you: legal exposure on a 6-month hold? finance impact on revenue recognition / credit accounting? Can we structure a conditional hold (i.e., hold applies only if commit uplift executed within 30 days)?

Please reply with recommended commercial language and whether we should present Option A vs B.

Thanks — Hannah

> 
> Appreciate the options. Two quick asks from procurement: ...
> 
> —Tom
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Jun 2028 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal & capacity plan — SaaSCo (term through 2029)

Hannah / team — my recommendation is Option A with tight conditional language. Proposed commercial terms to present:

1) Conditional 3-month rate-hold at current effective price starting on renewal in exchange for a +20% committed baseline (45M -> 54M tokens/mo). The rate-hold can be extended to 6 months only if the customer signs the commit uplift within 14 days of the amendment being executed and funds the first month of the uplift.

2) One-time usage offset credit of $25,000 to cover May overage (payable as account credit, not cash refund). Credit will be applied to the first invoice after renewal.

3) If customer does not fulfill the uplift within the 14-day window, the rate-hold reverts to 30 days and the uplift offer expires.

From a finance/legal perspective (Soojin, Markus): we should cap cumulative one-time credits to $30k per customer without Exec approval. Also need explicit language in the amendment about how the credit is applied and that credits do not change the committed quantity for SLOs.

I can draft a short amendment and route to Soojin for redline. I'll also generate a DocuSign link for signature.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

On Sun, Jun 3, 2028 Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> +1 to Ben's approach. Legal will accept a conditional 6-month hold only if uplift signature and first payment are captured within 14 days. We need a clause that the credit is non-transferable and expires if the agreement is terminated before the credit is applied. Will redline the amendment and return by Tuesday.
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Neal <tom.neal@saasco.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@saasco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: SaaSCo renewal — confirmation & next steps (MSA amendment attached)

Tom / Lydia —

Thanks for the candid ask and quick responses. Per our internal review, here's the proposal we're ready to move forward with:

Mutual Action Plan
- Amendment (attached: MSA_amendment_redline.docx) to implement:
  • Conditional rate-hold: Current effective pricing held for 3 months post-renewal.
  • Extension trigger: rate-hold extends to 6 months only if SaaSCo signs the attached amendment and remits the first payment for the +20% commit within 14 days of DocuSign completion.
  • Commit uplift: Baseline commit increases from 45M -> 54M tokens / month if uplift executed.
  • One-time usage credit: $25,000 applied as an account credit toward the first invoice after renewal.

Next steps
1) I'll upload the amendment to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123-SaaSCo-MSA (link active).
2) Please review the redline and sign; procurement can route the signature to Lydia / Tom.
3) Once signed and first uplift payment is received, we'll confirm the 6-month rate-hold and provision burst capacity.

If you'd prefer a straight 6-month hold without the uplift requirement, we can escalate to Sales Leadership, but that will require Executive approval and will likely change discounting.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through the amendment.

Best — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
